label: b24: hzanneal50, seed 3 of 8, 200M -- wave 1 of 1
notes: Batch b24, the user's horizon-anneal config at 200M, 8 seeds pinned to the arm letter, head to head with b25 (same cap, same seeds, same base: b2 reward, chase-safe 0.1 gate 75, fc 320, 128 lanes). Every anneal reaches its final value at 50% of the cap (SNEK_PPO_ANNEAL_FRACTION 0.5) and holds it: lambda 0.95 -> 0.999, gamma 0.99 -> 0.999 (new knobs SNEK_PPO_GAE_LAMBDA_FINAL / SNEK_PPO_DISCOUNT_FINAL, read at the step each rollout begins; the shaping discount follows gamma), entropy 0.01 -> 0.001. Fixed: lr 2.5e-4 (b11's densest), epochs 4, minibatch 512, T 256, clip 0.2, grad norm 0.5, adv norm on, huber, adam eps 1e-7, vf 0.5, target_kl 0. The advantage horizon 1/(1-gamma*lambda) runs 19 -> 500 steps: a short-horizon opening that b9/b10 say learns fast, landing on a near-Monte-Carlo end state (b9's lambda 1.0 plateau and b10's 0.999 both added drawdowns). Prediction: earlier onset than b25, then a denser but less stable second half -- more evals below 80 than b25, and best30 close; the record question is whether the long-horizon end state with huber holds at 200M where mse held at 50M. Read against b23's g999roll512msehold at 50M.
